name: dappier
label: Dappier
description: Enable fast, free real-time web search and access premium data from trusted media brands—news, financial markets, sports, entertainment, weather, and more. Build powerful AI agents with Dappier

token.label: API Key
token.description: Enter your Dappier API Key. You can generate one at https://platform.dappier.com/profile/api-keys.

real_time_web_search.label: Real Time Data
real_time_web_search.description: Access real-time Google web search results including the latest news, weather, travel, deals and more.

stock_market_data_search.label: Stock Market Data
stock_market_data_search.description: Access real-time financial news, stock prices, and trades from polygon.io, with AI-powered insights and up-to-the-minute updates to keep you informed on all your financial interests.

sports_news_search.label: Sports News
sports_news_search.description: Real-time news, updates, and personalized content from top sports sources like Sportsnaut, Forever Blueshirts, Minnesota Sports Fan, LAFB Network, Bounding Into Sports, and Ringside Intel.

query.label: Search Query
query.description: Enter a natural language query or URL

similarity_top_k.label: Number of Results
similarity_top_k.description: Number of articles to return (default is 9)

ref.label: Preferred Domain
ref.description: Restrict results to a domain (e.g., sportsnaut.com)

num_articles_ref.label: Guaranteed Articles from Domain
num_articles_ref.description: Minimum number of articles to match the preferred domain

lifestyle_news_search.label: Lifestyle News
lifestyle_news_search.description: Real-time updates, analysis, and personalized content from top sources like The Mix, Snipdaily, Nerdable, and Familyproof.
